reviewed_by: Claude Code after independent subagent root-cause validation and scratch-Core reproduction
reason: A work-lane HTTP command whose route already started its turn and only streams it (harness chat, provider chat start on http.invoke/v1) is renamed http.follow/v1 and lane heads skip it, so later project work no longer waits for the whole turn. Selected: durable delivery (new follow, inline/control and close regressions), runtime coordination claims, chat acceptance, the execution worker lane consumers, and the diagnostic-boundary worker test whose fake runner gained close(); SQLite and PostgreSQL.
exclusions: No UI, native or Playwright layer: the viewer keeps reading the same durable response. The harness chat end to end (project keeps serving while a harness turn never finishes) was measured on a fake scratch Core with a fake Codex app-server.
